استهلكت (form X)
# اِسْتَهْلَكْتُ (istahlaktu) /is.tah.lak.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
# اِسْتَهْلَكْتَ (istahlakta) /is.tah.lak.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
# اِسْتَهْلَكْتِ (istahlakti) /is.tah.lak.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
# اِسْتَهْلَكَتْ (istahlakat) /is.t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
